$comment: Curated tool catalog for /hyperdev:tools recommendations. Schema per tool: id, name, description, docs, repo, stacks[] (node|go|rust|python|any), aspects[] (lint|format|typecheck|test|security|ci|complexity|deps|docs|hooks|release), detect {config: [globs], bin} (both optional; absence means presence cannot be verified), notes (optional; conflicts and replacements). Read by scripts/hyperdev-recommend.sh.

tools.name: Biome
tools.description: Fast formatter + linter for JS/TS/JSON/CSS
tools.notes: replaces eslint+prettier; do not recommend alongside them

tools.name: ESLint
tools.description: Pluggable JS/TS linter, the ecosystem default
tools.notes: conflicts with biome and oxlint as the primary linter; pick one

tools.name: Prettier
tools.description: Opinionated code formatter for JS/TS/CSS/Markdown and more
tools.notes: biome and dprint cover the same job; do not run two formatters on the same files

tools.name: Oxlint
tools.description: Very fast Rust-based JS/TS linter from the oxc project
tools.notes: alternative to eslint (fewer rules, much faster); do not recommend alongside it

tools.name: Vitest
tools.description: Vite-native test runner with Jest-compatible API

tools.name: Knip
tools.description: Finds unused files, dependencies, and exports in JS/TS projects

tools.name: golangci-lint
tools.description: Aggregated Go linter runner (staticcheck, govet, and dozens more)
tools.notes: bundles staticcheck; running both separately is redundant

tools.name: Staticcheck
tools.description: Advanced Go static analysis (correctness, simplification, style)
tools.notes: already included in golangci-lint; standalone use only makes sense without it

tools.name: gofumpt
tools.description: Stricter drop-in replacement for gofmt

tools.name: govulncheck
tools.description: Official Go vulnerability scanner (reports only reachable vulns)

tools.name: Clippy
tools.description: Official Rust linter with hundreds of correctness and style lints

tools.name: rustfmt
tools.description: Official Rust code formatter

tools.name: cargo-audit
tools.description: Audits Cargo.lock against the RustSec advisory database
tools.notes: cargo-deny includes the same advisory check plus license/source policy

tools.name: cargo-deny
tools.description: Lints Cargo dependencies: advisories, licenses, bans, sources
tools.notes: superset of cargo-audit; running both is redundant

tools.name: cargo-nextest
tools.description: Faster Rust test runner with better output and flaky-test handling

tools.name: Ruff
tools.description: Extremely fast Python linter and formatter in one tool
tools.notes: covers what black+flake8+isort did; do not recommend those alongside it

tools.name: mypy
tools.description: The reference Python static type checker
tools.notes: pick one of mypy/pyright; two type checkers disagree more than they help

tools.name: Pyright
tools.description: Fast Python type checker from Microsoft (powers Pylance)
tools.notes: pick one of mypy/pyright; two type checkers disagree more than they help

tools.name: pytest
tools.description: De-facto standard Python test framework

tools.name: Bandit
tools.description: Finds common security issues in Python code (SAST)

tools.name: uv
tools.description: Fast Python package and project manager (lockfiles, venvs, tool runs)

tools.name: Gitleaks
tools.description: Scans repos and history for hardcoded secrets

tools.name: Semgrep
tools.description: Multi-language SAST with a large open rule registry

tools.name: OSV-Scanner
tools.description: Scans lockfiles across ecosystems against the OSV vulnerability database

tools.name: Trivy
tools.description: Scanner for dependencies, container images, IaC, and secrets

tools.name: Renovate
tools.description: Automated dependency update PRs across ecosystems

tools.name: Lefthook
tools.description: Fast, language-agnostic git hooks manager

tools.name: actionlint
tools.description: Static checker for GitHub Actions workflow files

tools.name: typos
tools.description: Fast source-code spell checker with a low false-positive rate

tools.name: dprint
tools.description: Pluggable multi-language code formatter (TS/JSON/Markdown/TOML and more)
tools.notes: overlaps prettier and biome formatting; one formatter per file type

tools.name: release-please
tools.description: Automated release PRs and changelogs from conventional commits
